sys.scale: Midscale — single-process desktop modulith, strict layer boundaries
stack: CustomTkinter 6.0 + Tk/ttk for widgets CTk lacks
sys.architectural_pattern: Layered modulith. Tk-free domain cores -> persistence -> ui_theme tokens -> ui/kit widget factory -> ui/pages screens -> app.py shell+handlers. Dependencies point one direction; cores are headless-testable.

ui_state.design_tokens: ui_theme.py — 4 palettes (dark/light + high-contrast pair), SPACING 4px scale, RADIUS incl. pill=100, FONT_STACK + THIN_FONT_STACK, gradient stops and glass composite colours. Pages request variants, never hex.
ui_state.motion_library: ui/kit.py Animator — after()-driven tweening, ease_out cubic. Page slide-in 220ms, stat count-up 400ms, progress ease 180ms. All gated on reduced_motion_var.
